name: Nie no Bansan
source:
A secret forbidden banquet is held every weekend. In the sea of lust a shy desire to escape and protect dear people arises in main character. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-october-2006-shuumatsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
每个周末都会举行一场秘密的禁忌宴会。在欲望的海洋中，主角心里萌生出想要逃离并保护心爱之人的羞怯愿望。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-october-2006-shuumatsu.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
